question: What portion above that division is assigned to the spread of the kūṭa?
premises: The level above is divided into eight parts.
This part defines the spread of the kūṭa.
inference: Above that, in the eight-part division, one śiva part is taken as the width of the kūṭa.
plain_english: Above that, in the eight-part division, one śiva part should be the spread of the kūṭa.
